create_evolution_tracer: create an EvolutionTracer instance to log program evolution traces to a JSONL file with buffered writes
log_evolution_trace: log a parent-child evolution trace entry with metrics, code, and LLM prompts using EvolutionTracer
calculate_improvement_delta: calculate the improvement delta between parent and child program metrics using EvolutionTrace
extract_checkpoint_traces: extract evolution traces from a checkpoint directory and save them as JSONL or JSON files
extract_full_lineage_traces: extract complete lineage chains with ancestor history and improvement steps from a checkpoint directory
